Patient Assessment
================

The Patient Assessment module records physical measurements and clinical assessments of patients during their care. This information helps track patient status and condition over time.

Data Collection Fields
--------------------

Physical Measurements
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Height**: Patient's height in centimeters
* **Weight**: Patient's weight in kilograms
* **Blood Pressure**: Systolic and diastolic blood pressure in mmHg
* **Temperature**: Body temperature in degrees Celsius
* **Pulse**: Heart rate in beats per minute
* **Respiratory Rate**: Breathing rate in breaths per minute

Clinical Assessment
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Date of Assessment**: When the assessment was performed
* **Performance Status**: Patient's functional status using standardized scales
* **Assessment Notes**: Any additional relevant observations

Special Considerations
--------------------

1. Measurement standards:

   #. Use consistent units for all measurements
   #. Calibrate measuring equipment regularly
   #. Document any special circumstances affecting measurements

2. Timing of assessments:

   #. Record the specific date and time
   #. Note if assessment was done during routine visit or due to specific concerns
   #. Document frequency of planned assessments

3. Performance status:

   #. Use standardized performance status scales
   #. Document any changes from previous assessments
   #. Note any factors affecting performance evaluation
